title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G084 G085 G090 G093 G096
note: Five-case regression batch covering grouped quantity thresholds, anti-joins by customer name, paired aggregate aliases, empty related-row detection, and earliest-date ties.

cases.question: Show orders containing more than one unit in total.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 1 ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: List customers who have never placed a cancelled order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'Cancelled') ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Find maximum and minimum product prices in one result.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS maximum_price, MIN(price) AS minimum_price FROM products;

cases.question: Show completed orders that have no matching order items, if any.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND oi.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: List orders with the earliest order date, including ties.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date = (SELECT MIN(order_date) FROM orders) ORDER BY order_id;
